integrity: The stated proof derives finite-life ellipse areas and asymptotics directly from the polynomial vector field. Finite checker diagnostics do not replace an analytic proof. No independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact real-plane cubic slice with nonnegative damping only; Euclidean area is not a probability measure; no assertions about other homogeneous polynomials or discrete approximations. Prior explicit radial solution is acknowledged.
title: Nested escape-time ellipses and a neutral-to-damped survival-area crossover in a rigid cubic flow
